title: Sellers Controller get Profile -  Verify a suspended seller's own profile view clearly reflects the suspended status.
scenario: Pre-existing valid JWT; account suspended mid-session via admin action; replaying the old token on GET /sellers/me returns 401 'Account suspended.' - NOT 200, no profile body, no status field to inspect
preconditions: Needs a dedicated, disposable seller account to suspend (not ST_USER/ST_ADMIN, which must stay unsuspended for other tests) plus an admin JWT to call PATCH /admin/users/:id/suspend. No such fixture exists in fixtures.json/conftest.py/factory.py today.
steps: 1) Login as a disposable seller, capture JWT. 2) As admin, PATCH /admin/users/:id/suspend for that seller. 3) GET /sellers/me with the step-1 (pre-suspension) JWT
expected: 401 'Account suspended.', confirming Finding #1 (not 200 with a visible status)
source: audit EP-109 suggested scenario #4; jwt.strategy.ts:34-62 (:42); apiClient.refresh.test.ts:119-124
test_data: Dedicated seller fixture needed: mint a JWT as that seller, then admin suspends via PATCH /admin/users/:id/suspend, then replay the pre-suspension JWT against GET /sellers/me
response_assertions: body.message == 'Account suspended.'; response contains no profile fields at all (no 200 path exists)
business_outcome: Suspension is enforced at the auth layer (JwtStrategy.validate), live from the DB, before SellersController.getProfile ever runs - a suspended seller can never reach a 200 from this endpoint
unchecked: No dedicated/disposable suspended-seller fixture exists; requires an admin JWT to create one via PATCH /admin/users/:id/suspend (admin.controller.ts:160-165) using an account other than the shared ST_USER/ST_ADMIN test accounts, plus a way to capture a pre-suspension JWT for replay.

title: Sellers Controller get Profile -  Verify a suspended seller's own profile view clearly reflects the suspended status.
scenario: Malformed/expired/tampered JWT on GET /sellers/me returns 401, no 500/leak
preconditions: Needs a literal invalid-signature token and/or a known-expired token string - not mintable via the harness's normal login flow (hooks.py RoleAuth only logs in a real account or sends no token at all; it cannot inject an arbitrary garbage Authorization header)

title: Sellers Controller get Profile -  Verify a suspended seller's own profile view clearly reflects the suspended status.
scenario: Session revoked via 'sid' check (e.g. sign out all devices) then retry GET /sellers/me with the old token - 401 with a message distinct from suspension
preconditions: Needs a mechanism to revoke a session's sid (e.g. a 'sign out all devices' endpoint/call) - not scripted anywhere in factory.py/conftest.py; no fixture or helper for this exists in the harness today
steps: 1) Login as seller, capture JWT. 2) Trigger session revocation (sign out all devices / sid invalidation). 3) GET /sellers/me with the old (now-revoked) JWT
test_data: Owner JWT + a way to revoke its sid
response_assertions: body.message == 'Session ended. Please sign in again.' - must be distinct from 'Account suspended.'
business_outcome: Confirms the 401 reason/message for a revoked session differs from a suspended account, which matters for any client-side error-message mapping that tries to distinguish the two
unchecked: No scripted mechanism/fixture exists in this harness to revoke a session's sid (no 'sign out all devices' call in factory.py/conftest.py) - cannot execute until one is added
